annotations.title: Calculate UK tourist tax (visitor levy) on a booking

description: UK only. Works out the tourist tax (visitor levy) a holiday let, B&B, guest house, hotel, hostel or campsite owes on one booking: Edinburgh 5% (first 5 nights, live since 24 July 2026), Glasgow 5% (from 25 January 2027), Aberdeen 7%, Stirling 3%, West Dunbartonshire 5%, Cardiff £1.30 per person per night (from 1 April 2027). Returns the levy, how it was worked out, and the return deadline. Free. The host owes it even when booked through Airbnb or Booking.com.

accommodation_price_gbp.description: What the guest paid for the nights (Scotland): include any booking fee the GUEST paid inside the booking; leave out meals, separately charged parking, optional extras and the tax itself.

accommodation_type.description: Type of accommodation. Hostel dorm beds and tent pitches pay the lower Welsh rate.

booked_on.description: Date the booking was made, YYYY-MM-DD. Optional: older bookings can be exempt.

cleaning_fee_gbp.description: Compulsory one-off fees such as cleaning (Scotland). These count towards the levy.

guests.description: Number of people on the booking, including children and babies (Wales).

under_18s.description: How many of the guests are under 18 (Wales lower rate only).

vat_registered.description: True if the host is VAT registered (Scotland: the levy is worked out on the price without VAT).

name: calculate_uk_tourist_tax
